tools.name: save-note
tools.title: Save a note
tools.description: Save a note for the team: a decision, a how-to, meeting minutes, anything worth remembering. Saving with the title of an existing note replaces it. Use when someone says to note, remember, write down or record something.

title.description: A short, specific title, e.g. Release checklist

tools.name: list-notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List the titles of every saved note. Use when someone asks what notes exist, or before reading one whose exact title you do not know.

tools.name: read-note
tools.title: Read a note
tools.description: Read one note in full, by its title or its uri.

note.description: The note's title, or its uri from list-notes or find-notes

tools.name: find-notes
tools.title: Find notes
tools.description: Search the saved notes by meaning and return the most relevant passages. Use when someone asks a question the team may have written down, and you do not know which note holds the answer.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words

limit.description: How many notes to return. Defaults to 5

tools.name: delete-note
tools.title: Delete a note
tools.description: Delete one note, by its title or its uri. Confirm with the person first.

note.description: The note's title, or its uri
